title: Dora the Explorer Airship
description: A fox-like anthropomorphic character with glowing yellow eyes stands atop a rusty steampunk airship, one paw raised. The vessel's door is open revealing a shadowy figure inside, floating above a sprawling gothic city of clock towers and bridges at dusk, with a large map of 'Foulwater' in the foreground.
prompt: A rusty copper steampunk airship floats in the air with its door open, revealing a shadowy figure with purple scarf inside reaching out. On top of the vessel stands an anthropomorphic fox with glowing yellow eyes and a mischievous expression. Below is a dark gothic fantasy city filled with clock towers and bridges at sunset. In the foreground is an old parchment map labeled Foulwater. Dramatic purple and orange sky with smoke and embers, dark whimsical atmosphere.
